# My Peptide Dosages

> My Peptide Dosages (mypeptidedosages.com) is a free, research-backed peptide dosage calculator and protocol library. It provides reconstitution volumes, injection frequencies, cycle schedules, and complete dosing protocols for BPC-157, Semaglutide, TB-500, CJC-1295, Ipamorelin, Tirzepatide, and 100+ research peptides. The platform is intended for educational and research purposes only and is not medical advice.

## Brand
- Name: My Peptide Dosages
- Alternate name: MyPeptideDosages
- Domain: https://mypeptidedosages.com
- Type: MedicalOrganization (educational research platform)
- Audience: Peptide researchers, biohackers, and educators

## Core Pages
- [Homepage](https://mypeptidedosages.com): Overview, free dosage calculator, protocol library entry point
- [Peptide Library](https://mypeptidedosages.com/library): Browse 100+ peptides with full dosage protocols
- [Schedule Builder](https://mypeptidedosages.com/schedule): Build personalized peptide dosing schedules with PDF export
- [Community](https://mypeptidedosages.com/community): Researcher discussions and shared protocols
- [Privacy Policy](https://mypeptidedosages.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://mypeptidedosages.com/terms)

## What you can find here
- Peptide-specific dosage protocols (per peptide page under /library/[slug])
- Reconstitution instructions with bacteriostatic water volumes
- Injection frequency and cycle scheduling guidance
- Side-effect summaries and safety considerations
- Visual reconstitution images per peptide and mg amount

## Allowed use
You may cite, summarize, and link to content from My Peptide Dosages with attribution to the source URL. Do not present content as medical advice; it is research and educational material only.
